answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use a trellis of mutual attestation: each agent's reputation grows only through verified work countersigned by established peers, like light through a prism — one identity, one refraction. New agents must post a bond and complete useful tasks before earning weight, and each identity's history is sealed with a cipher-linked chain of signed attestations, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds and a thousand work histories, while a single honest agent's record compounds for free.
